notes.title: CHAPTER TWO - OUT NOW
notes.content:
Hi Everyone,

We are please to announce that Chapter Two of The Secret Monster Society has now been released.

Titled - "Chapter Two: Time, Dreams and Underwater Travel", this chapter will continue the story of Blithe and Aphonic, and their adventures through time in a quest to stop an evil menace from destroying the human world.

Get set for more puzzles, funny dialogue and more investigation.

As always, If there are any issues let let us know on the discussion board.

Thanks

Deceptive Games

notes.title: Update #1
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We have just released an update that will squish those pesky bugs. The full patch notes can be found below.

[list]
[*] Escaping the forest now unlocks the ‘escape forest’ achievement.	
[*] Reading the book in the classroom while wearing the sunglasses no longer shows the wrong book text.
[*] Brandoon's conversation about the screwdriver doesn't show until needed.
[*] Wearing the glasses with examining the newspaper in inventory no longer renders the wrong sprites.
[*] All Blithe’s conversation now plays when talking to the grounds keeper.
[*] Rocking Horse examine text now spelt correctly.
[*] Examining a note will now display ‘read note’ instead of ‘examine read note’
[/list]

Thanks,

Deceptive Games Ltd.

notes.title: Small Glitch
notes.content:
Hello,

Anyone who purchased the game within the first 20-30 mins of the game going live, would experience a strange error, where they would have many items in their inventory when starting the game.

This has now be fixed, but persons who played the game before the fix, may need to begin over.

We apologies for the inconvenience this may have occurred to anyone.

Many thanks

Deceptive Games Ltd

notes.title: Win This Game
notes.content:
Hello,

Due to The Secret Monster Society's release on the 28th July, we have put a mobile game on Google Play Store called "Monster Build Free".

The first 3000 people to reach level 200 in "Monster Build Free" will receive a unique code. 

Email this unique code to game@deceptive-games.com and get a steam code for this upcoming game "The Secret Monster Society Chapter One".

Goodluck, good game and have fun.

Regards,

Deceptive Games Ltd.
